name: GitNexus
description: GitNexus: The Zero-Server Code Intelligence Engine - GitNexus is a client-side knowledge graph creator that runs entirely in your browser. Drop in a git repository (Github, Gitlab, Azure, Local) or ZIP file, and get an interactive knowledge graph with a built in Graph RAG Agent. Perfect for code exploration
one_liner: A tool that reads any codebase and draws you a map of how all its pieces actually connect, right in your browser, no setup required.
buyer: A software consultant who needs to quickly understand an unfamiliar client codebase before quoting a project.
business_use_cases: A consulting firm audits a client's undocumented legacy codebase before scoping a rewrite or migration project.
A new engineering hire self-serves an understanding of an unfamiliar codebase instead of repeatedly interrupting teammates.
An open-source maintainer generates an architecture overview automatically to help new contributors ramp up.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a fixed-price "codebase audit report" package for companies that just inherited undocumented code.
Build a hosted team version that keeps the knowledge graph updated automatically as the codebase changes.

steal_this: Offer a fixed-price "legacy codebase audit" package this weekend to a company that just inherited an undocumented system — point this at their repo and hand them a findings report in a day.
